purpose: Acquire only the literal Dryad README PDF already identified in landing metadata, then inspect bounded offline schema/methods documentation. Preserve the separate blocked Li route and do not select or admit a benchmark.

transport.allowed_delivery_hosts: datadryad.org or subdomains of datadryad.org; documented public object-storage delivery host patterns *.s3.amazonaws.com, *.s3.<region>.amazonaws.com, s3.<region>.amazonaws.com, storage.googleapis.com, *.storage.googleapis.com. HTTPS only, no userinfo or non443 port; no arbitrary hosts/IP literals.
transport.receipt: Record every response status and host/path; signed query values are never persisted or printed. Query presence and parameter names may be recorded. Stop on first denial, unknown delivery host, redirect limit, size limit, network failure or nonPDF; no mirror or fallback.

offline_parser.tools: Bounded pdfinfo and pdftotext subprocesses only; no JavaScript, actions, embedded files, external links or network execution.
offline_parser.projection: Raw extracted text remains ignored. Before researcher display replace all digit-bearing numeric tokens, including signed/exponent forms, with [NUMBER]. Inspect documentation for field names/units, calculation/record pairing, missingness, versions/identity and advertised-count statements only. Do not recover target-example numeric literals. If extraction/layout is unreadable, stop instead of opening a different source.

exposure: The entire PDF and any numeric examples it contains are machine read by the parser. Raw extracted text can contain numeric examples; it is not shown to the researcher or published. Redacted documentary prose may still expose qualitative details or example identities. Earlier paper qualitative exposure remains; no fresh/untouched-source claim.
forbidden: JSON dataset or other file download
Extracting numeric target examples or numerical scientific outcomes
Joins, fits, comparisons, benchmark criteria, threshold/allocation changes or admission
Full PDF or raw extracted text publication pending rights review
retention: Retain original PDF bytes, exact hashes and initial errors locally. Public copyset contains only scope, scripts, redacted redirect/access receipts, selected schema facts/own paraphrase and provenance. Raw PDF/text and signed query values excluded.
limits: README schema descriptions do not verify data bytes, actual completeness, independent units or equivalence to the processed matminer/Figshare object. Dataset version1 versus filenamev3 remains a separate question unless this document explicitly resolves it.
